themes_detail.label: Park Noise Surge
themes_detail.summary: Noise complaints from parks spiked to 4 this week vs. 0.9 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks—a 357% increase (z-score: 5.21)—suggesting either new activity patterns, events, or enforcement gaps in Sunnyside/Woodside's park system this week.
evidence: 4 park noise complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.9 weekly average (8-week baseline)
Coincides with seasonal warming and potential increased park usage
reporting_angles: Interview Parks Dept. about new park programs, events, or increased foot traffic driving complaints
Canvass residents near major parks (Sunnyside Park, etc.) about noise sources and timing

themes_detail.label: Building Maintenance Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Maintenance or facility complaints jumped to 16 this week vs. 6.6 weekly average—a 142% spike (z-score: 4.0)—suggesting accelerating deterioration of public or private infrastructure across the district this week.
evidence: 16 maintenance/facility complaints THIS WEEK vs. 6.6 weekly average (8-week baseline)
666 DOB building permits filed in last 90 days (480 alterations) suggest ongoing construction activity
reporting_angles: Review 311 complaint details to identify which facilities are failing (schools, libraries, senior centers, NYCHA)
Cross-reference with ongoing development projects and rezoning applications that may be disrupting infrastructure

themes_detail.label: Outdoor Dining Complaints Explode
themes_detail.summary: Outdoor dining complaints surged to 6 last week vs. 0.6 weekly average—an 860% increase (z-score: 5.42)—indicating rapid expansion of sidewalk/street dining that is generating resident friction or enforcement challenges in Sunnyside/Woodside.
evidence: 6 outdoor dining complaints last week vs. 0.6 weekly average (8-week baseline)
Suggests post-pandemic or seasonal surge in restaurant outdoor seating demand
reporting_angles: Document which restaurants are newly expanding outdoor dining and where complaints are concentrated
Interview business owners about demand and residents about impacts (seating obstruction, noise, odor, sanitation)

themes_detail.label: Panhandling Complaints Spike
themes_detail.summary: Panhandling complaints reached 6 three weeks ago vs. 0.8 weekly average—a 700% increase (z-score: 6.33)—the oldest spike in this dataset but with highest z-score, reflecting sustained or emerging homelessness/street poverty concentration in the district.
evidence: 6 panhandling complaints 3 weeks ago vs. 0.8 weekly average (8-week baseline)
700% increase with z-score of 6.33 (highest statistical severity in dataset)
No subsequent week-to-week data provided; unclear if spike has sustained or resolved
reporting_angles: Determine if 3-week-old spike has persisted; check most recent weeks' 311 data for trend continuation
Map complaint locations to identify hotspots (transit stations, commercial strips, parks) and interview service providers, NYPD, and affected residents

themes_detail.label: Dead Animal Disposal Backlog
themes_detail.summary: Dead animal complaints reached 6 last week vs. 1.5 weekly average—a 300% spike (z-score: 5.2)—potentially indicating sanitation gaps, vermin infestation, or seasonal animal die-off patterns in Sunnyside/Woodside.
evidence: 6 dead animal complaints last week vs. 1.5 weekly average (8-week baseline)
Street Condition complaints remain elevated at 1,540 over 90 days (long-running concern)
reporting_angles: Contact Sanitation Dept. about response times and disposal protocols; identify where carcasses are concentrated
Interview residents and community board about rodent/pest conditions and whether dead animals signal broader infestation
